accounts.name: policy
docs: A standing permission on chain: this header, then its terms.

fields.name: rolled
docs: When `consumed` was last written.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent; it goes back there.

fields.name: index
docs: Its number among the authority's policies.

accounts.name: nonces
docs: One page of the nonces an authority's signed intents have used or cancelled.

fields.name: index
docs: The nonce index its intents were signed under.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent; it goes back there.

accounts.name: profile
docs: An authority's profile: it numbers its policies and holds what invalidates them and its intents.

fields.name: policies
docs: How many policies it has created; they are numbered from 1.

fields.name: stale
docs: Every policy numbered this or less is invalid.

fields.name: nonceIndex
docs: What its intents are signed under.

instructions.name: create
docs: Put a policy on chain, under the next number of the profile.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent; it goes back there.

instructions.name: pull
docs: Take tokens under a policy, and deliver what the authority must receive.

accounts.name: from
docs: The authority's token account.

accounts.name: to
docs: Where the tokens go: the one the terms name, or the spender's choice.

accounts.name: payFrom
docs: The spender's token account, if the authority receives something.

arguments.name: reference
docs: The spender's own id for this pull. Emitted, not stored.

instructions.name: close
docs: Close what can never be used again, and return its rent. Anyone may.

accounts.name: account
docs: A policy that expired or was invalidated, or a page of nonces under an old nonce index.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The recorded payer; receives the rent.

instructions.name: open
docs: Create the authority's profile, once.

instructions.name: invalidate
docs: End every policy so far, every intent so far, or both.

arguments.name: what
docs: 1 for policies, 2 for intents, 3 for both.

instructions.name: fill
docs: Run a signed intent, once.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the page of nonces if it is new; it goes back there.

accounts.name: from
docs: The authority's token account.

accounts.name: to
docs: Where the tokens go: the one the terms name, or the spender's choice.

accounts.name: payFrom
docs: The spender's token account, if the authority receives something.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: The authority ends one thing: a policy, or with a salt one signed intent.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A policy: its recorded payer. An intent: a signer that funds the page of nonces.

accounts.name: account
docs: The policy, or the page of nonces of the intent.

arguments.name: salt
docs: The intent's salt. None for a policy.

definedTypes.name: envelope
docs: What comes before the intent text in the bytes the authority signed.

variants.name: text
discriminator: Nothing: the text alone, as `solana:signMessage` signs it.

variants.name: offchainMessage
discriminator: The Offchain Message v1 preamble, as `solana:signOffchainMessage` signs it.

definedTypes.name: per
docs: What the limit counts over.

fields.name: seconds
docs: Fixed windows of this length, counted from `notBefore`. Nothing carries over.

definedTypes.name: limit
docs: What may go out: at most `max` of `mint` may leave `from`, a token account of the authority.

fields.name: to
docs: The only token account the tokens may go to. None leaves it to the spender.

definedTypes.name: decay
docs: The minimum moves in a straight line to `min` between `t0` and `t1`.

definedTypes.name: receive
docs: What must come in: each use, at least `min` of `mint` arrives in `to`, a token account of the authority.

definedTypes.name: terms
docs: What an authority permits: the same for a policy and for a signed intent.

fields.name: cluster
docs: 0 mainnet, 1 devnet, 2 testnet, 3 localnet: the cluster the program was built for.

fields.name: spender
docs: Who may pull. None is anyone.

fields.name: salt
docs: A signed intent's nonce. A policy does not use it.

errors.name: notSigner
errors.message: Account expected to be a signer

errors.name: notMutable
errors.message: An account this program writes directly must be writable

errors.name: invalidAccountOwner
errors.message: Account expected to be owned by this program

errors.name: invalidAccountLength
errors.message: The account data length is not the expected one

errors.name: invalidTag
errors.message: The account's tag is not the expected type

errors.name: invalidSeeds
errors.message: The account is not the PDA for its seeds

errors.name: alreadyInitialized
errors.message: The profile exists already

errors.name: malformedTerms
errors.message: The terms bytes are not a canonical encoding

errors.name: invalidTerms
errors.message: The terms break a validity rule (`Terms::validate`)

errors.name: wrongCluster
errors.message: The terms are for another cluster

errors.name: invalidAuthority
errors.message: The signer is not the terms' authority

errors.name: invalidSignature
errors.message: The signature does not cover the rendered terms

errors.name: nonceUsed
errors.message: The intent's nonce was used: it ran already, or was cancelled

errors.name: unrenderable
errors.message: A timestamp outside years 1970–9999 cannot be rendered

errors.name: notYetValid
errors.message: The terms' window has not opened

errors.name: expired
errors.message: The terms' window has closed

errors.name: invalidSpender
errors.message: The signer is not the terms' spender

errors.name: notClosable
errors.message: A policy in force, or a page of nonces whose index is the profile's: `Close` takes only what can never be used again

errors.name: invalidPayer
errors.message: The account is not the one that paid the rent being refunded

errors.name: invalidPull
errors.message: The account pulled from is not the one the terms limit

errors.name: limitExceeded
errors.message: The pull exceeds the limit

errors.name: invalidTarget
errors.message: A token account or mint is not the one the terms name, or not the authority's

errors.name: overflow
errors.message: An amount overflowed

errors.name: notReceived
errors.message: The authority received less than the terms require

errors.name: invalidEventAuthority
errors.message: Only the engine PDA may invoke the event instruction

errors.name: notDelegate
errors.message: The engine is not the delegate of the account pulled from: it was never enabled, another `Approve` replaced it, or its approval ran out

errors.name: allowanceExceeded
errors.message: The pull exceeds what is left of the account's approval

errors.name: insufficientFunds
errors.message: The account pulled from holds less than the pull

errors.name: invalidProfile
errors.message: The account is not the authority's profile, or the authority has none

errors.name: stale
errors.message: The authority invalidated this policy

errors.name: invalidDestination
errors.message: The tokens would not go to the account the terms name

errors.name: inexactAmount
errors.message: An intent anyone may fill for nothing in return runs for its whole amount, or a stranger could use it up for less
